name: long vambraces
_design_note: F40-80 medium-heavy arms slot. Articulated forearm plate with flared wrist guard. Bridge between iron_vambraces and plate_vambraces.
lore_template: These long {material_name} vambraces are hinged at the elbow and flare at the wrist into a cup that catches a blade and steers it wide, and by that flare a parry may be turned into an opening.
